description:
A modern Rust/Tauri desktop frontend for watching Twitch streams via Streamlink.


Stream GUI RS 1.7.1
Changes since Stream GUI RS 1.7.0.
This patch release fixes Streamlink detection and playback from the Linux AppImage.
Fixes
- Fixed "Streamlink could not be detected" in the Linux AppImage when Streamlink is installed on the host with Python, for example through a distribution package, pip, pipx or a virtual environment (#97, #98). The AppImage launcher set Python, library and search-path variables that pointed into the bundle, and Streamlink inherited them. Streamlink and the player now get the host environment back; other variables, such as proxy settings, pass through unchanged. DEB, RPM, Windows and macOS packages were not affected.
Dependencies
- Updated tauri-plugin-single-instance to 2.5.5, tao to 0.37.2, wry to 0.57.1, uuid to 1.29.0, webbrowser to 1.2.5, aws-lc-rs to 1.19.0 and other locked Rust and npm dependencies (#92, #93, #94, #95).
- CI and release builds now use Node.js 26 (#91).
Upgrade and platform support
Settings stay at schema 10; upgrade from 1.7.0 without signing out or clearing settings.
Streamlink 8.0+ and a separately installed player remain required. Package formats remain Windows x86_64 installer and portable/Scoop ZIP; Linux x86_64 AppImage, DEB and RPM; and a universal macOS DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel requiring macOS 11.0 or later. Verify downloads against the accompanying SHA-256 files.
